subject: ss-haematology
title: Acute myeloid leukaemia APL and targeted care
refs: Harrison Principles of Internal Medicine 22e Ch 109 Acute Myeloid Leukemia

steps.tx: **Acute myeloid leukaemia** (AML, myeloid blast cancer) packs blood, marrow and tissues with clonal poorly differentiated cells, and untreated disease is uniformly fatal. The United States sees about **20,380** new cases yearly, median age **69**, with only **32** percent survival at **5** years. **Blasts** (immature cells) at or above **20** percent define AML, although certain genetic lesions lower the bar. **ELN** (European LeukemiaNet) risk groups steer every decision.
steps.say: Acute myeloid leukaemia is a fast fatal blast disease without treatment. Median age at diagnosis is sixty nine years. Blasts at or above twenty percent define the disease.

steps.tx: Genetics now classifies disease. **WHO 2022** (World Health Organization classification) defines AML with **PML RARA** fusion, **RUNX1 RUNX1T1**, **CBFB MYH11** and **KMT2A** rearrangements as genetic entities. **NPM1** (nucleophosmin mutation) without **FLT3** internal tandem duplication favours good risk, while **TP53** (tumour suppressor mutation), complex karyotypes and **MYC** adverse lesions mark poor risk. **CEBPA basic leucine zipper** (bZIP, transcription factor) in frame mutations are favourable.
steps.say: Genetic lesions now define acute myeloid leukaemia categories. NPM1 without FLT3 favours good risk, while TP53 marks poor risk. CEBPA bZIP mutations are favourable.

rows: RUNX1 RUNX1T1 CBFB MYH11 NPM1 no FLT3

steps.tx: **Acute promyelocytic leukaemia** (APL, M3 variant with **PML RARA** fusion) bleeds catastrophically through **DIC** (disseminated intravascular coagulation) and hyperfibrinolysis. **ATRA** (all trans retinoic acid) plus **arsenic trioxide** (ATO) differentiates blasts and cures over **95** percent, but **differentiation syndrome** (lung and fluid toxicity) kills when missed. **Fibrinogen** (clotting factor) replacement and early ATRA before genetic proof save lives, since coagulopathy precedes confirmation.
steps.say: Promyelocytic leukaemia bleeds through extreme coagulopathy. ATRA plus arsenic cures over ninety five percent. Differentiation syndrome needs steroids the moment breathlessness appears.

steps.tx: Fit patients receive **7 plus 3** (seven days cytarabine with three days anthracycline) induction, with **gemtuzumab** (CD33 antibody drug) added in core binding variants. **FLT3 inhibitors** (gilteritinib, midostaurin) join induction and maintenance in FLT3 mutant disease. **Ivosidenib** (IDH1 inhibitor) and enasidenib (IDH2 inhibitor) exploit differentiation therapy in mutant disease. **Measurable residual disease** (MRD, lingering leukaemia marker) guides transplant and maintenance choices.
steps.say: Fit patients receive seven plus three induction with gemtuzumab in core binding disease. FLT3 inhibitors join mutant disease care. IDH inhibitors exploit differentiation therapy.

steps.tx: Unfit patients receive **venetoclax azacitidine** (BCL2 blocker plus hypomethylating agent) as the standard, lifting survival beyond older options. **Ivosidenib** (IDH1 blocker) curative in mutant unfit disease proves genotype first. **CLL1** (myeloid surface marker) and **CD33** (myeloid antigen) anchor antibody and cellular therapies in trials. **Growth factor** support and **infection** prophylaxis shape survival as much as chemotherapy does.
steps.say: Venetoclax with azacitidine is the unfit standard. Ivosidenib cures mutant unfit disease in some patients. Infection prophylaxis shapes survival as much as chemotherapy.

steps.tx: **HSCT** (stem cell transplantation) consolidates adverse and intermediate risk disease in first remission, and graft versus leukaemia immunity cures otherwise fatal relapse. **MRD** (measurable residual disease) negativity predicts durability, while **donor lymphocyte infusion** (DLI, donor immune cells) rescues early relapse. **Myeloablative** (full intensity) conditioning suits young patients and **reduced intensity** suits older adults. **HSCT** timing follows ELN risk plus MRD, not age alone.
steps.say: Transplantation consolidates adverse risk disease in first remission. MRD negativity predicts durable control. Conditioning intensity follows fitness, not habit.

steps.tx: Complications dominate course. **Tumour lysis** (metabolic meltdown) needs hydration and **rasburicase** (urate enzyme) in proliferative disease. **Leukostasis** (white cell lung and brain clogging) with counts above **100,000** needs hydroxyurea, hydration and urgent cytoreduction. **Gum hypertrophy** (swollen gums), **skin leukaemia cutis** (skin deposits) and **CNS spread** (brain involvement) mark monocytic variants. Maintenance prophylaxis follows transplant protocols.
steps.say: Tumour lysis needs hydration and rasburicase in proliferative disease. Leukostasis needs urgent cytoreduction. Monocytic variants infiltrate gums, skin and brain.

steps.tx: Predisposition is wider than taught. **Fanconi anaemia** (DNA defect), telomere disorders, **GATA2** (transcription factor) deficiency and **Down syndrome** with trisomy 21 raise AML risk sharply. Therapy related leukaemia follows **alkylators** (DNA damaging drugs) and **topoisomerase** (DNA unwinding blockers) exposure. **MDS progression** (precursor disease) carries adverse mutations. **Germline testing** in young patients increasingly guides donor choice, since sibling donors may share predisposition.
steps.say: Fanconi anaemia and Downs syndrome raise leukaemia risk sharply. Therapy related leukaemia follows alkylators and topoisomerase blockers. Young patients need germline testing before donor selection.

steps.tx: **CLL1** (leukaemia stem marker) trials and **bispecific antibodies** (dual target T cell engagers) promise relapse options, while **menin inhibitors** (protein blockers) exploit **KMT2A** rearrangement biology. **FLT3** inhibition extends beyond fit patients into maintenance settings. **Allogeneic transplant** remains the only curative relapse tool for most adults. **Quality of life** endpoints parallel survival in older unfit cohorts now.
steps.say: Menin inhibitors exploit KMT2A rearrangement biology. Bispecific antibodies promise relapse options. Transplantation remains the curative relapse tool for most adults.

steps.tx: Numbers to recite: **20** percent blast threshold with genetic exceptions; **7 plus 3** backbone; APL cure above **95** percent with ATRA arsenic; **venetoclax azacitidine** as unfit standard; **MRD** guided transplant; **leukostasis** above **100,000** blasts; and **ELN** favourable lesions RUNX1 RUNX1T1, CBFB MYH11, NPM1 without FLT3 and CEBPA bZIP. Never delay ATRA for proof when APL is suspected.
steps.say: ATRA is never delayed for proof when APL is suspected. Seven plus three remains the fit backbone. MRD guides transplant and maintenance decisions.
